gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the add-on multicolor units for two of its recommended enclosed printers are tied to specific models: the QIDI Box comes in separate Plus4, Q2 and Max4 versions (different Box Hub and signal cable, $40.99 kit to move it to another printer), and Creality's K1-series CFS upgrade kit for the K1C works only with the integrated-nozzle hotend and keeps the top cover from closing fully, so the K1C stops being fully enclosed for ABS unless you print the height-extension part.
standout_why: I read the cited rival firstlayerlab.com/enclosed-3d-printers. It names the P1S, P2S, X2D, H2D, CORE One+, K1C, K2 Plus and Q2 but only says 'most enclosed models accept an automatic filament changer', and names no AMS, QIDI Box or CFS. I also read the cited 3dprintgearlab.com/best/corexy-3d-printer. It gives P1S AMS combo prices ($479 AMS, $509 AMS 2 Pro) but says nothing on multicolor compatibility for the P2S, Q2, K1C or AD5M Pro. The cited popularmechanics.com page would not load for me, so I couldn't check it. Neither page I read mentions QIDI Box versions, the CFS hotend limit, or the CFS top-cover problem.
decides: This backs the QIDI Q2 as the pick for a shopper who wants an enclosed printer for ABS/ASA now and multicolor later. QIDI's US Q2 page says it works with the QIDI Box, and QIDI says the Box can dry and print at the same time (up to 65 °C) and chain up to 4 units. Buy the Q2 version of the Box, or plan $40.99 for the upgrade kit if you move it to another printer. It counts against the Creality K1C for the same shopper. ChatGPT pitched it as 'enclosed', but adding Creality's CFS means an integrated-nozzle hotend, a top cover that no longer closes fully (Creality supplies height-extension files for ABS), and a smaller 220 × 215 × 250 mm print volume. The finding doesn't change the pick for a shopper printing PLA/PETG in one color.

findings.label: Moving a Box to a different QIDI printer
findings.value: Needs the model-specific QIDI BOX Upgrade Accessory Kit, $40.99 (compare-at $64.99). A Box bought separately already includes the kit for its own model
findings.source_title: QIDI BOX Upgrade Accessory Kit – QIDI US store
findings.note: QIDI's own example: a PLUS4 QIDI Box later used on a Q2 needs the Q2 upgrade kit.

findings.label: Units per printer, and what is needed for 2 or more
findings.value: Up to 4 Boxes (16 materials). Connecting 2 or more needs an extra expansion accessory
findings.note: Spec table says '≤4' expandable units. The US store sells a 'QIDI BOX Hub and Signal Cable' at $35.99 that merges tubes from several Boxes into one output (us.qidi3d.com/products/qidi-box-hub-and-signal-cable, read 2026-11-08).

findings.label: Filaments the maker excludes
findings.value: Not supported: TPE, generic TPU, PVA (damp), BVOH (damp), TPU 95A, QIDI PAHT-CF. Supported: ABS-CF/GF, PLA-CF/GF and TPU 64D
findings.note: Maker's filament compatibility list on the product page.

findings.label: Drying
findings.value: Up to 65 °C. Can dry and print at the same time

findings.label: CFS multicolor upgrade: models covered and hotend requirement
findings.value: The K1 Series CFS Upgrade Kit covers the K1, K1 Max, K1C and K1 SE but 'is only compatible with the integrated nozzle hotend'. A separate (split) hotend 'will not work'. The integrated hotend kit is sold separately for $32.99
findings.source_title: Creality's K1-Series CFS Upgrade Kit: Everything You Need to Know – Creality Community (Creality Blog)
findings.note: Article posted 2025-04-09 by the 'CREALITY' account in the Creality Blog category. How to tell the hotends apart: the integrated hotend has no set screws.

findings.label: Effect of the CFS upgrade on the enclosure
findings.value: The PTFE tube must enter vertically, 'which prevents the top cover from fully closing'. For ABS, Creality says the kit 'requires some additional modifications' and provides a height-extension file for the K1/K1C cover. Print volume with the kit drops to 220 × 215 × 250 mm (stock K1C is 220 × 220 × 250 mm)
findings.source_title: Creality's K1-Series CFS Upgrade Kit: Everything You Need to Know – Creality Community (Creality Blog)
findings.note: Stock 220 × 220 × 250 mm volume taken from ChatGPT's K1C card. The 215 mm Y figure is Creality's.
